events.evidence: A car bomb in Baghdad, Iraq, kills at least 16 people in a cafe with young men watching a football match
The Reserve Bank of India increases interest rates by 50 basis points to 7.25 per cent
José Sócrates, the Prime Minister of Portugal, announces a bail out deal with the European Union and International Monetary Fund

label.note: Bin Laden aftermath, Middle East attacks, Portugal bailout and RBI hike keep risk appetite weak.
